import { syncProgress, uploadsTracker, rclone } from '/src/services/index.ts'; // Elements const statusIndicator = document.getElementById('status-indicator'); const syncState = document.getElementById('sync-state'); const progressFill = document.getElementById('progress-fill'); const progressPercent = document.getElementById('progress-percent'); const taskList = document.getElementById('task-list'); const uploadList = document.getElementById('upload-list'); const lastSyncEl = document.getElementById('last-sync'); // Stats elements const statPending = document.getElementById('stat-pending'); const statSyncing = document.getElementById('stat-syncing'); const statCompleted = document.getElementById('stat-completed'); const statFailed = document.getElementById('stat-failed'); // Subscribe to sync progress syncProgress.onProgress(updateUI); function updateUI(status) { // Update connection status const dot = statusIndicator.querySelector('.status-dot'); const text = statusIndicator.querySelector('span:last-child'); if (status.isOnline) { dot.className = 'status-dot ' + (status.isSyncing ? 'syncing' : 'online'); text.textContent = status.isSyncing ? 'جاري المزامنة' : 'متصل'; } else { dot.className = 'status-dot offline'; text.textContent = 'غير متصل'; } syncState.textContent = status.isSyncing ? 'جاري المزامنة...' : 'جاهز للمزامنة'; // Update progress progressFill.style.width = status.overallProgress + '%'; progressPercent.textContent = Math.round(status.overallProgress) + '%'; // Update stats statPending.textContent = status.pendingTasks; statSyncing.textContent = status.isSyncing ? 1 : 0; statCompleted.textContent = status.completedTasks; statFailed.textContent = status.failedTasks; // Update current task if (status.currentTask) { updateTaskList([status.currentTask]); } // Update last sync if (status.lastSyncAt) { lastSyncEl.textContent = 'آخر مزامنة: ' + formatDate(status.lastSyncAt); } } function updateTaskList(tasks) { if (!tasks || tasks.length === 0) { taskList.innerHTML = `
📭

لا توجد مهام حالياً

`; return; } taskList.innerHTML = tasks.map(task => `
${getTaskIcon(task.operationType)}
${getTaskName(task.operationType)}
${task.entityType}: ${task.entityId}
${getStatusText(task.status)}
`).join(''); } function getTaskIcon(type) { const icons = { 'file_upload': '☁️', 'person_creation': '👤', 'file_id_generation': '🔢', 'server_notification': '📡', 'batch_sync': '🔄' }; return icons[type] || '📋'; } function getTaskIconClass(type) { if (type.includes('upload')) return 'upload'; if (type.includes('person')) return 'person'; return 'sync'; } function getTaskName(type) { const names = { 'file_upload': 'رفع ملف', 'person_creation': 'إنشاء شخص', 'file_id_generation': 'توليد رقم ملف', 'server_notification': 'إشعار الخادم', 'batch_sync': 'مزامنة مجمعة' }; return names[type] || type; } function getStatusText(status) { const texts = { 'pending': 'معلق', 'in_progress': 'جاري', 'in-progress': 'جاري', 'completed': 'مكتمل', 'failed': 'فاشل' }; return texts[status] || status; } function formatDate(date) { if (!date) return 'غير معروف'; const d = new Date(date); return d.toLocaleDateString('ar') + ' ' + d.toLocaleTimeString('ar'); } // Button handlers document.getElementById('btn-sync-now').addEventListener('click', async () => { await syncProgress.forceSyncNow(); }); document.getElementById('btn-retry-failed').addEventListener('click', async () => { const retried = await syncProgress.retryFailedTasks(); alert(`تم إعادة ${retried} مهمة`); }); document.getElementById('btn-refresh').addEventListener('click', async () => { const status = await syncProgress.getOverallStatus(); updateUI(status); }); // Initial load (async () => { const status = await syncProgress.getOverallStatus(); updateUI(status); // Load upload stats const uploadStats = await uploadsTracker.getStats(); // Update upload list... })();
